Sofia, I couldn't find a named night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor in anything you can see. I checked #coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general, #help-it-ops, your DMs with me and the Coastal digests.

The Coastal cheat sheet says Driftmoor Marine Freight's tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. It also says engineering provided a manual CSV patch "for the night dispatcher". It doesn't give a name, an email or a phone number, so I won't guess one.

Kwame is the best person to ask, since you said the contact is his. If you get a name, I can help draft the patch note. Anything addressed outside pemberline.com needs Ruth Calloway's approval first, even as a draft.
